text.en:
Section one of the Republic Act Numbered Twenty-one hundred and ninety-five is amended to
read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The barrios of Sibuco and Malayal and the sitios of Cawit-Cawit, Anungan, Parang-Parang, Mantibo,
Panganuran, Sarawagan, Lawi-Lawi, Tigbuaya, Pantamalitog, Maga, Pangian, Malog, Paniran, Lintangan,
Limason and Siluput in the Municipality of Siocon, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, are separated from said
municipality to be known as the Municipality of Sibuco, same province, with the seat of government at the
present site of the barrio of Sibuco."
